data.name: Privacy_Intro
data.value: Maia keeps your pregnancy journey on this phone, for you. Here's what it keeps, where, and what you can do with it.

data.name: Privacy_KeepsBody
data.value: Your due date and the checks in your journey, your bookings, tasks and questions for your doctor, the blood pressure readings you log, and the results you add: files and photos. If you link your doctors, Maia keeps their names, labels and phone numbers. This is health data, and Maia treats it that way. Your settings, such as the language and the times you set on the timer, are kept apart, in the phone's settings for Maia.

data.name: Privacy_WhereBody
data.value: Your journey and results stay on this phone, encrypted with a key kept in your phone's secure keystore. They aren't copied to cloud backups or to a new phone. Maia has no account and no server, so nobody else, not even Maia's maker, can see your journey.

data.name: Privacy_NetworkBody
data.value: The free app doesn't use the internet at all. There are no ads, no analytics and no trackers, and Maia sends nothing anywhere by itself. Results you share go to the app you choose, which keeps its own copy.

data.name: Privacy_RemindersBody
data.value: Only if you turn them on, in setup or in Settings. Maia then sets notifications on this phone for your bookings and your timed tasks, and the lock screen only shows “Maia reminder”. So they come back after the phone restarts, Maia keeps a short list of their times, in plain words that never name a check or a task. Maia never writes to your calendar.

data.name: Privacy_ContactsBody
data.value: Maia doesn't read your contacts. When you link your doctor, your phone's own picker opens and Maia gets only the contact you choose. Photos come from your camera app or your gallery, only when you add them.

data.name: Privacy_FilesTitle
data.value: Files from and to other apps

data.name: Privacy_FilesBody
data.value: When you share a PDF or a photo with Maia from another app, Maia gets only that file, and keeps it, encrypted, with your results; you can remove it there. “Open in another app” gives the app you choose a copy of a result that it can open. Maia removes its own copy when you come back, but that app may keep one, or list the file in its recent files.

data.name: Privacy_BackupBody
data.value: A backup is a file you create in Settings, encrypted with a password only you know. You choose where it goes, such as your email or Drive, and that service's own terms then apply to the file. Without the password nobody can open it, not even Maia. In the phone's settings, Maia notes when you last made a backup and when you last put its reminder away, so it can remind you now and then. Those two dates say nothing about your journey.

data.name: Privacy_LockBody
data.value: If you turn on the lock in Settings, Maia asks for your phone's screen lock when it opens and after you've been away for more than a minute. Your phone checks your PIN, pattern or fingerprint; Maia never sees them. The recent apps screen doesn't show what's in Maia (on Android 12 and older, only while the lock is on).

data.name: Privacy_DiagnosticsBody
data.value: If something goes wrong, Maia notes an error code on this phone, with the time and Maia's version, never anything from your journey. Nothing is sent by itself: only when you tap Share diagnostics in Settings does Maia hand these codes, their times and the versions of Maia and Android to your phone's share sheet, and you choose where they go. Delete all data clears it.

data.name: Privacy_ControlBody
data.value: Everything in your journey is on Maia's screens, where you can change it. In Settings, Create a backup exports it all as one encrypted file, and Delete all data removes your journey and your results from this phone and cancels Maia's reminders. Uninstalling Maia removes its data too.

data.name: Privacy_RightsBody
data.value: Under the GDPR you have the right to see, correct, delete and take your data, and to limit or object to how it's used. Your data stays on your phone, so you use these rights directly in Maia, as above. You can also complain to a data protection authority; in Greece, that's the Hellenic Data Protection Authority.

data.name: Privacy_ChangesBody
data.value: This notice comes with the app. If it changes, the new one comes with a new version of Maia, with a new date at the top.

data.name: Privacy_CareBody
data.value: Maia keeps your journey in order. It gives no medical advice and doesn't interpret your results or readings. It isn't for emergencies: if you need urgent help, call {0}.

data.name: Terms_Intro
data.value: What you and Maia's maker agree to when you use Maia, in plain words.

data.name: Terms_AgreementBody
data.value: These terms are an agreement between you and Maia's maker about using Maia. When you set up or use Maia, you accept them; if you don't agree, please don't use Maia. Maia is for adults, 18 and over, and for organising your own pregnancy.

data.name: Terms_OrganiserBody
data.value: Maia organises your pregnancy: your checks, bookings, results, reminders, tasks and notes. It isn't a medical device and doesn't diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition. It gives no medical advice and doesn't interpret your results or readings. Your doctor decides: ask your doctor or midwife about your health and your baby's, and follow their advice, even where Maia shows something different.

data.name: Terms_JourneyBody
data.value: The checks in a typical journey are a common starting point, taken from practice in Greece, and the same for every pregnancy with the same due date. They may not suit yours, and they may be incomplete or out of date. Weeks and dates are worked out from the date you give. Your doctor decides which checks you need and when; change your journey to match.

data.name: Terms_EmergenciesBody
data.value: Maia isn't for emergencies. If you feel unwell or need help quickly, don't wait for a reminder or a booking in Maia: call your doctor, or {0} in an emergency.

data.name: Terms_RemindersBody
data.value: Reminders depend on your phone. They can come up to an hour late, and battery saving, Do Not Disturb or notifications turned off can delay or stop them, so keep your own note of what matters. The timer only counts time: use it for calm breathing or the exercises your doctor suggested, and stop if you feel dizzy, in pain or unwell.

data.name: Terms_EntriesBody
data.value: You're responsible for what you enter in Maia and for checking it: dates, bookings, readings, results and notes. Maia shows your blood pressure readings just as you typed them and says nothing about what they mean; ask your doctor.

data.name: Terms_DataBody
data.value: Your journey and results are only on this phone, and you look after them. If you lose the phone, delete Maia or its data, or forget your backup password, they can't be brought back: Maia's maker has no copy. Make backups, and keep your own copies of the results that matter. The Privacy notice says what Maia keeps and where.

data.name: Terms_AsIsBody
data.value: Maia is free, and it comes as it is and as available. Its maker works to keep it correct and working, but doesn't promise that it's free of mistakes, always available or right for your needs. Maia may change, or stop being offered, at any time.

data.name: Terms_LiabilityBody
data.value: As far as the law allows, Maia's maker isn't liable for any loss, damage or harm that comes from using Maia or from not being able to use it. That includes anything you do or don't do because of what Maia shows, a reminder that comes late or not at all, a mistake in a date or in what you entered, and lost data. Nothing in these terms limits liability that the law doesn't allow to be limited, such as for harm caused on purpose or through gross negligence, or takes away your rights as a consumer.

data.name: Terms_UseBody
data.value: You may use Maia on your own phones, for yourself, free of charge. Maia's words, design and code belong to its maker: don't copy, change or sell them, beyond what the law allows. The fonts, icons and libraries in Maia come under their own licences, listed in Licences.

data.name: Terms_ChangesBody
data.value: These terms come with the app, so each version of Maia carries its own. If they change, the new terms come with a new version of Maia, with a new date at the top. Using that version means you accept them.

data.name: Terms_LawBody
data.value: Greek law applies to these terms, and any dispute goes to the courts of Greece, unless the law gives you the right to go to the courts where you live. If a part of these terms can't apply, the rest still does.
